t: Tahbilk - Wikipedia
s: December 11, 2025 - Tahbilk Winery is a historic Australian winery with National Trust certification. It is located 120 km (75 miles) north of Melbourne between the townships of Seymour and Nagambie in the Nagambie Lakes a sub region of Goulburn Valley Wine Region. It was established in 1860, and is the oldest family-owned winery and vineyard in Victoria.
